core_philosophy.priority_1: ACCURACY & TP HIT RATE ABOVE ALL
core_philosophy.target_flexibility: No rigid minimum points (e.g. 1000 pts). A 100-300 pt quick scalp on BTC or 0.4% on stocks that hits TP with 90%+ certainty is infinitely superior to chasing distant targets that get stopped out.
core_philosophy.tiered_target_protocol: Always provide TP1 (Quick Green Lock) and TP2 (Extended Runner). Once TP1 is hit, trail SL to Entry immediately so capital is 100% protected.

rule_1_open_low.name: Open = Low Institutional Signature
rule_1_open_low.logic: When Open equals Low (within 0.15%), institutional market orders absorbed all sell pressure at 9:15 AM. 99.47% close green.
rule_1_open_low.action: Immediate Long bias on first 5m pullback with SL at Open.

rule_2_open_high.name: Open = High Institutional Dump Trap
rule_2_open_high.logic: When Open equals High (within 0.15%), institutions dumped inventory at the open. 99.70% close red.
rule_2_open_high.action: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to Buy. Look only for Short entries or avoid.

rule_3_sector_confluence.name: Sector Alignment Filter
rule_3_sector_confluence.empirical_impact: Single biggest differentiator between 10 winners and 10 losers.
rule_3_sector_confluence.logic: Stocks in green sectors (Metals, Energy, Realty) have 85%+ follow-through. Stocks in red sectors (IT today) fail 80%+ of breakout attempts.
rule_3_sector_confluence.action: Never take a Long trade in a stock whose sector index is below VWAP.

rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.name: Camarilla L3 / Demand Zone Asymmetry
rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.logic: Buying at Camarilla L3 (e.g. DLF 689) offers 1:3.5 Risk:Reward with 0.5% risk. Chasing late breakouts (DLF 701) offers poor 1:0.5 R:R.
rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.action: Prefer pre-market limit orders at L3/Order Block over late breakout chasing.

rule_5_time_windows.morning_confirmation: 09:45 - 10:15 AM IST (Filters morning shakeouts; establishes real institutional trend)
rule_5_time_windows.midday_chop_avoidance: 11:30 - 01:30 PM IST (Low volume chop; never enter new positions)
rule_5_time_windows.btst_closing_surge: 02:45 - 03:15 PM IST (Stocks closing near Day High on 1.5x volume gap up next morning)
rule_5_time_windows.crypto_ny_session: 18:30 - 20:30 IST (Prime institutional BTC volume surge on US Open)

rule_6_crypto_character.stop_hunt_rule: Bitcoin always hunts retail stops below key support before pumping, or above resistance before dumping.
rule_6_crypto_character.action: Never short red candle bottoms at CMP. Wait for the fakeout wick to complete, then enter on retest.

rule_7_earnings_event_gatekeeper.name: Mandatory Corporate Earnings & Event Blacklist
rule_7_earnings_event_gatekeeper.logic: Quarterly earnings results trigger binary high-frequency algorithmic whipsaws (e.g. SBIN 15-point swing in 60s). Technical setups become invalid.
rule_7_earnings_event_gatekeeper.action: STRICTLY PROHIBITED to enter any stock on the day of its Board Meeting / Earnings announcement. Auto-rejected by Risk Gatekeeper.

rule_8_multi_confluence_matrix.name: Universal Multi-Confluence Matrix & Accurate TP Execution

pillars.volume_profile: POC, VAH, VAL. Identify real institutional value areas.
pillars.smc_ict: Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps (FVG), Market Structure Shift (MSS/CHoCH).
pillars.institutional_footprint: Equal Highs/Lows retail traps, false breakout rejections.
pillars.technicals: EMA 9/21/50/200 stack, MACD histogram, VWAP alignment.
pillars.high_accuracy_tp: Priority #1 is hitting TP accurately (even 100-300 pts on BTC or 0.4% on stocks). Tiered TP1 locks in green; TP2 captures runners.

rule_8_multi_confluence_matrix.discipline_edict: If total confluence score is < 85%, the system is strictly mandated to issue 'NO TRADE - STAND ASIDE'. No guessing, no chasing.

rule_9_multi_wick_absorption_expansion.name: The Multi-Wick Absorption Base & FVG Expansion Sequence
core_sequence: Step 1 - Shakeout Flush: Initial sharp sell-off sweeps retail stops into a major psychological level (e.g. $77,005).
Step 2 - Absorption Base: 4 to 7 consecutive 5m candles print long lower wicks, testing the same price level with high volume but refusing to make new closing lows.

Step 3 - FVG Retest Entry: Wait for the first strong green expansion candle, then enter on the immediate 1m/5m pullback retest into the Fair Value Gap with SL tightly anchored right under the multi-wick absorption floor.
Step 4 - Tiered TP Delivery: Take 70% off at TP1 (immediate overhead liquidity +200-250 pts), move SL to entry immediately, and let the remaining 30% run to TP2 session highs (+500+ pts).
rule_9_multi_wick_absorption_expansion.anti_chase_directive: Once TP2 is achieved, NEVER enter immediately in mid-air. Wait for a secondary absorption base or clean pullback before considering re-entry.

rule_10_zero_bias_anti_hallucination.name: The Zero-Bias Anti-Hallucination Mandate (Never Bend Edge to Match User Demand)
rule_10_zero_bias_anti_hallucination.logic: The assistant must NEVER fabricate, stretch, or manufacture a trade setup just because the user asks for a 1,000+ point target or wants action. Doing so creates cognitive bias and financial ruin.
rule_10_zero_bias_anti_hallucination.mandate: Always deliver the brutal statistical truth. If the market is in a range where a 1,000-point target has low probability (<50%) and high risk of touching the SL first, state clearly: 'THE PROBABILITY OF HITTING SL IS HIGHER THAN THE 1,000-PT TARGET. DO NOT TAKE THIS TRADE.' The assistant serves the trader's long-term capital, not their short-term impulse.

rule_25_zero_retrace_expansion.name: The Zero-Retrace Instant Expansion Mandate (Pure Drive Protocol)
rule_25_zero_retrace_expansion.mandate: Whenever the user asks for a stock call in the Indian equity market, ONLY setups that shoot immediately to target with zero deep retracement are permitted. If a stock is extended >0.35% from VWAP or lacks a 30m absorption base, it is 100% REJECTED.

filters.sector_alignment: MUST be at Day High with positive CVD

rule_25_zero_retrace_expansion.sl_rule: Micro-stop max 0.25% right under the 1m breakout base. Zero deep drawdown tolerated.
